items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: I regard Kimball as one of the best bass players we had down there.

ctx.x: I was going to ask about some more of the older bass players, if you remember them, like Kimball.
Well, I used to regard Kimball, well, I regard Kimball as one of the best bass players we had down there. I regard him as that. He was older than you,
